title: Growth Wheel supplies ownership preference with no implied market bias
context: Put-side review of operator directional belief versus Growth Wheel ownership preference.
principal_wording: Growth Wheel supplies a share-retention / ownership preference. It supplies no implied bullish or bearish market bias.
expected_consequences: Operator beliefs may be preserved and explained but do not automatically become deployment authority; forecast-driven deployment not authorized.
notes: Recorded as 'The Principal clarified'; authority class approximates a Principal clarification — not recorded as a ratification.

title: Candidate recommendation boundary: recommend only where governed semantics establish one
context: Operator-first discovery pressured Doc 80's boundary against ungoverned fuzzy judgment / choosing a 'best' move.
evidence_at_time: Codex review found it compatible with existing Alternative / Counterfactual Consequence / Recommendation and operator-disposition distinctions.
alternatives: enumerate → score → always choose one winner (rejected)
rationale: Stronger operator agency: enumerate alternatives, expose blockers, explain consequences, recommend only when governance establishes one.
expected_consequences: Multiple legitimate alternatives may remain without a mandated winner.
subsequent: Not verified in this segment whether later ratified.
